questions.prompt: Why does a large collection of data still need a suitable model and objective?
options: Data must be transformed into task-relevant outputs; quantity alone does not guarantee useful decisions.
A sufficiently large dataset makes the choice of prediction target irrelevant.
The model can recover any missing variable merely by reading the file format.
A model objective only controls storage size, not the behavior learned.
questions.explanationZh: 数据是原材料，模型与目标决定如何提取任务信息。大量数据不能替代目标定义、代表性检查与质量控制。
distractorsZh: 错误目标仍会得到不符合需要的输出。
未观察的信息不能靠文件格式保证恢复。
优化目标直接影响模型学习的行为。

refs.reasonZh: 数据与模型的互补作用

questions.prompt: A monitoring system must process incoming measurements within milliseconds. Which big-data V is most directly involved?
options: Volume.
Variety.
Veracity.
Velocity.
questions.explanationZh: Velocity关注数据到达与处理速度。即使累计数据量不大，低延迟流式处理仍可能是主要挑战。
distractorsZh: Volume主要指规模，不直接表述时延要求。
Variety主要指数据形式多样。
Veracity主要指可信度与不确定性。

refs.reasonZh: 数据流速度与处理需求

questions.prompt: Which progression moves from raw observations toward increasingly interpreted and actionable understanding?
options: Wisdom → Knowledge → Information → Data.
Data → Wisdom → Information → Knowledge.
Data → Information → Knowledge → Wisdom.
Knowledge → Data → Wisdom → Information.
questions.explanationZh: DIKW以数据为基础，经组织解释形成信息，再形成可应用知识与判断。它是帮助区分层次的概念框架，不是自动保证正确决策的流水线。
distractorsZh: 这是相反方向。
直接跳到智慧后又退回信息，不符合该框架。
把原始数据放在知识之后。

questions.prompt: Which pairing correctly describes the four Vs of big data?
options: Volume: reliability; Velocity: variety; Variety: speed; Veracity: scale.
Volume: scale; Velocity: speed; Variety: diverse forms; Veracity: reliability and uncertainty.
Volume: speed; Velocity: scale; Variety: reliability; Veracity: forms.
Volume: storage format; Velocity: label meaning; Variety: accuracy; Veracity: vector length.
questions.explanationZh: 四个V分别强调规模、速度、形式多样性以及真实性/可靠性。它们描述不同挑战，数据量大不意味着其余三方面也得到解决。
distractorsZh: 把可靠性、规模和速度等混淆。
交换了四个维度的含义。
这些含义不是四V的定义。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of mapping text to numerical features in a classifier?
options: To let the model compare and transform task-relevant properties using numerical operations.
To prove that meaning has been completely understood before training.
To make every document identical regardless of its content.
To replace class labels with file-size rankings.
questions.explanationZh: 数值表示把文本属性转换为可计算对象，支持距离、乘法和学习。字符存储编码、任务特征表示和语义理解是不同层次。
distractorsZh: 可计算表示不等于完整理解。
表示应保留任务所需差异。
文件大小排名不等于文本分类目标。

questions.prompt: A dataset combines audio, tables, and free text, but many entries contain unreliable claims. Which pair of challenges is present?
options: Only volume and velocity.
Only velocity and dimensionality reduction.
Only storage compression and class imbalance.
Variety and veracity.
questions.explanationZh: 音频、表格、文本体现形式多样性；不可靠内容体现数据真实性/可信度问题。题目没有给出规模、流速或类别比例，不能凭空推断。
distractorsZh: 题目没有强调数据规模或到达速度。
没有描述流速，也没有指定降维任务。
没有给出压缩率或类别分布。

questions.prompt: Which association correctly distinguishes Boolean vectors, count vectors, and learned embeddings?
options: Embeddings are simply the document word-count column renamed.
Boolean vectors indicate presence; count vectors indicate frequency; embeddings encode learned contextual relationships.
Boolean vectors preserve exact word order; counts encode sentence syntax.
All three representations must have exactly one nonzero coordinate.
questions.explanationZh: 第13页依次强调 presence、frequency、context。第16页词嵌入是d维语义向量，可用word2vec等标准资源或训练领域/情感嵌入；它不是TF-IDF加一个固定列。
distractorsZh: 词嵌入由学习目标产生，不等同计数。
布尔和计数词袋通常都丢失词序。
多热向量与稠密嵌入均不满足唯一非零。

refs.reasonZh: 三种表征分别保留什么
三种表征分别保留什么

questions.prompt: A vocabulary is [red, blue, car, bus]. What Boolean vector represents the document “red car car”?
questions.explanationZh: 布尔表示只记录每个词是否出现，所以car出现两次仍为1。维度等于词表大小4；文档可有多个1，严格说是multi-hot，而单词one-hot只有一个1。
distractorsZh: 遗漏了red。
这是词频向量而非布尔向量。
按句长设维度破坏了固定词表坐标。

questions.prompt: With N documents and document frequency df(t), which weighting expression gives rarer terms a larger IDF?
options: (1 + log tf(t,d)) × log(df(t) / N).
tf(t,d) × N, with no document-frequency term.
log(0) for every absent term, retained as a finite weight.
(1 + log tf(t,d)) × log(N / df(t)), when tf(t,d) > 0.
questions.explanationZh: 第15页写log(n/N)但未清晰定义符号，第32页明确采用log10(N/df_t)。应先定义N总文档数、df出现该词的文档数；非零TF取1+log tf，未出现项记0而不是计算log0。原始词频、TF-IDF都可用于词袋，词袋不必“基于TF-IDF”。
distractorsZh: 该比值会使更罕见词得到更负的值。
忽略了跨文档稀有程度。
log0未定义，必须分段处理。

questions.prompt: A term–document matrix has terms as rows and documents as columns. What does entry X[i,j]=5 mean in a raw-count matrix?
options: Document i contains five distinct terms from column j.
Document j has probability 5 of belonging to class i.
Term i is absent from document j but has vocabulary index 5.
Term i occurs five times in document j.
questions.explanationZh: 行确定词项，列确定文档，元素记录该词在该文档中的出现次数。计数无需在一列内归一化为概率。
distractorsZh: 交换了行列并把出现次数误当不同词数。
概率不能为5，而且该表不是类别后验表。
正计数意味着出现，而非缺席。

questions.prompt: Using IDF(t)=log(N/df(t)), what IDF does a term receive if it occurs in every one of the N documents?
options: N.
An undefined value caused by division by zero.
Zero.
One, regardless of log base.
questions.explanationZh: df(t)=N，因此log(N/N)=log1=0。广泛出现的词在该IDF定义下没有跨文档区分力；某些软件会加入平滑或常数，必须按明确公式作答。
distractorsZh: N是文档数而非对数结果。
分母为N，不是0。
log1为0，不是1。

refs.reasonZh: IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重
IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重
IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重

questions.prompt: Why might happy and sad be closer in a general embedding space than in a sentiment-oriented space?
options: They may occur in similar contexts, while a sentiment objective emphasizes opposite polarity.
A word pair has the same distance in every trained embedding space.
Opposite sentiment implies the words can never share contexts.
CBOW predicts surrounding words from a single target, as its standard definition.
questions.explanationZh: 第16页用happy/sad说明上下文相似与任务极性不同：普通嵌入可能接近，情感嵌入需区分。该页把CBOW方向写反；以第110页为准，CBOW上下文→中心词，Skip-gram中心词→上下文。
distractorsZh: 训练语料、目标和参数都会改变空间。
反义词常在相似语法语境出现。
这是Skip-gram方向，非标准CBOW。

refs.reasonZh: 领域目标改变happy/sad关系与CBOW纠错
领域目标改变happy/sad关系与CBOW纠错

questions.prompt: In a term-document vector-space model, what determines the number of dimensions?
options: The number of classes predicted by the classifier.
The number of words in the current query only.
Exactly three dimensions for every possible text collection.
The vocabulary size |V|.
questions.explanationZh: 第20页词项为轴、文档为点/向量。示意依次|V|=1、2、3；网页检索可能有数千万维，不能把画图维度当实际维度。
distractorsZh: 类别数与输入词空间维度不同。
词表不是当前查询的长度。
三维图只是教学投影。

questions.prompt: Why can a learned semantic representation consider “car” and “automobile” similar even though the strings differ?
options: Cosine similarity first requires the two strings to have exactly the same spelling.
Semantic similarity is determined entirely by the number of characters.
Any two words with different IDs must have cosine similarity zero in every representation.
Learned coordinates can capture related usage instead of assigning unrelated words orthogonal identity axes.
questions.explanationZh: 词项身份编码与语义嵌入不同。one-hot的不同词坐标正交；学习型表示可利用相近语境让不同词接近，但并不保证所有近邻都可互换。
distractorsZh: 向量相似度不要求拼写相同。
字符长度不能决定语义。
这一结论只适用于特定正交编码，不适用于所有表示。

refs.reasonZh: 语义关系与词项独立轴的区别

questions.prompt: Why can Euclidean distance rank a long document poorly even when its term proportions resemble the query?
options: Cosine similarity compares only the number of documents.
Its vector magnitude can be much larger despite a similar direction.
Euclidean distance is undefined for all text vectors.
Identical proportions force identical raw counts.
questions.explanationZh: 第22页q与d2方向相近但距离较大，坐标轴以GOSSIP与JEALOUS作示意。距离同时受长度和方向影响，不能把“可能不合适”写成所有文本任务禁用欧氏距离。
distractorsZh: 余弦比较向量夹角。
数值化后欧氏距离可以正常定义。
比例相同不意味着总量相同。

refs.reasonZh: 欧氏距离受文档长度影响

questions.prompt: For a nonzero raw-count vector d, what happens when its document is concatenated with itself?
options: The new vector is 2d, with cosine similarity 1 to d but generally nonzero Euclidean distance.
The new vector is -d, so cosine similarity is -1.
Both vectors become zero after concatenation.
The Euclidean distance is always zero because the topic is unchanged.
questions.explanationZh: 按原始词频或固定IDF的线性加权，复制后d′=2d，夹角0，cos=1，欧氏距离为||d||。若用1+log tf，对数变换不再严格保持所有坐标等比例；第23页直觉必须注明表征假设。
distractorsZh: 复制不会把符号取反。
复制不会清空词频。
语义相同不代表数值向量相同。

refs.reasonZh: 文档复制后的角度与距离

questions.prompt: What is the cosine similarity of q=(1,1) and d=(2,0)?
options: 2, because the unnormalized dot product is 2.
0, because the second coordinates differ.
1, because both vectors contain a positive coordinate.
1/√2, approximately 0.707.
questions.explanationZh: cos(q,d)=(q·d)/(||q||||d||)=2/(√2×2)=1/√2。点积与归一化是第24页公式的两个部分；零向量需要另定处理规则。
distractorsZh: 漏除了范数。
余弦不是逐格相等检测。
存在正值不能推出完全同向。

questions.prompt: After both vectors are normalized to unit length, how is cosine similarity computed?
options: As the sum of their coordinate-wise absolute differences.
As the number of nonzero terms divided by the class count.
As their dot product.
As the product of their original document lengths.
questions.explanationZh: 第24页给出归一化后cos(q,d)=Σq_i d_i。第32页比较欧氏距离√Σ(x_i−y_i)²和TF-IDF余弦。补充推论：单位向量有||q−d||²=2−2cos(q,d)，此时二者排序相容；不同输入处理不可混比。
distractorsZh: 那是L1距离，不是余弦。
这不是本页任何相似度定义。
已经移除了原长度影响。

refs.reasonZh: 单位向量上的余弦及距离
单位向量上的余弦及距离

questions.prompt: Which list consists of methods for reducing a high-dimensional representation?
options: More duplicated columns, more zero rows, and longer documents.
Feature selection, truncated SVD, and random projections.
Naive Bayes, majority voting, and one-versus-all.
Token labels, class names, and confusion matrices.
questions.explanationZh: 第25页问题是稀疏、矩阵过大/过高，列出feature selection、TSVD、random projections。它们是不同路线，不是必须顺序执行的三步。
distractorsZh: 通常扩大而非压缩表示。
属于分类/组合策略而非此处三项。
不是降维算法列表。

refs.reasonZh: 稀疏高维问题和三个降维路线

questions.prompt: Which sequence describes truncated singular-value decomposition?
options: Factorize the matrix, retain the largest k singular components, and reconstruct a rank-k approximation.
Assign labels, fit an SVM, and delete its support vectors.
Sort documents alphabetically and retain the first rows.
Discard the largest singular values before factorization.
questions.explanationZh: 第26页写1 Factorize，2 Discard some singular values，3 Rebuild，并画X=UΣVᵀ。截断通常保留最大k个奇异值及对应方向，删除较小分量。
distractorsZh: 这不是矩阵分解流程。
按名称排序与低秩近似无关。
必须先分解；通常保留主导分量。

questions.prompt: If X has shape m×n, what shape does the reconstructed rank-k matrix U_k Σ_k V_k^T have?
options: k×k in every case.
n×m because the product always transposes X.
m×k, identical to the left factor U_k.
m×n; its rank is reduced even though the reconstruction has the original shape.
questions.explanationZh: 原矩阵重建仍m×n；降维坐标可单独取Σ_kV_kᵀ（k×n）或U_kᵀX。不要把“低秩重建”和“低维坐标”混成一个对象。第27页3D→2D是坐标投影直觉。
distractorsZh: k×k是Σ_k的形状。
因子乘积重建X而非Xᵀ。
忽略了后续因子。

questions.prompt: What is a valid expectation about distances and angles after a truncated-SVD projection?
options: Every pairwise angle must remain mathematically identical for every retained rank.
Every discarded direction is guaranteed to contain only noise.
Any one-dimensional projection preserves all pairwise distances exactly.
Important structure may be approximately retained, but every pairwise distance and angle need not remain identical.
questions.explanationZh: 截断丢弃部分方向，通常会改变距离和角度。保留主要结构是近似目标，不是对所有点、所有秩的等距保证。
distractorsZh: 截断可能改变角度。
较小奇异方向仍可能含任务信号。
一般高维点集无法如此无损压到一维。

refs.reasonZh: 低维几何只可能近似保留

questions.prompt: In a truncated-SVD approximation, what tradeoff generally arises when fewer singular components are retained?
options: All details are preserved exactly for every input matrix.
The number of retained components has no effect on approximation capacity.
Lower storage/computation can come at the cost of greater reconstruction error.
The reconstructed matrix must gain rank.
questions.explanationZh: 保留较少成分提供更紧凑的表示，但通常丢失更多细节。对固定矩阵，增加截断秩可使最佳低秩近似误差非增；这不等于下游任务分数必定上升。
distractorsZh: 被丢弃的非零成分会产生重建误差。
k正是近似容量的重要控制量。
较少保留成分不能提高秩上界。

questions.prompt: A two-dimensional projection places several words close together. What is the most careful interpretation?
options: All original high-dimensional distances must be reproduced exactly.
They may share structure in the learned representation, but projection proximity alone does not prove exact synonymy.
Every pair must be interchangeable in every sentence.
Every axis must correspond to a named human emotion.
questions.explanationZh: 低维图是检查表示结构的线索。近邻可能来自共现、主题或其他关系，投影也可能失真，因此不能仅凭图判断严格同义。
distractorsZh: 低维投影一般会丢失几何信息。
相近不代表任何语境下可互换。
分布式维度不必有明确人类名称。

refs.reasonZh: 可视化邻近不等于语义定论

questions.prompt: A system is trained on documents labeled finance, sport, or science. What is its supervised classification task for a new document?
options: Assign one of the learned category labels from its features.
Discover clusters without using the provided labels.
Output a raw word-count matrix instead of a category.
Create a unique new label for every document by definition.
questions.explanationZh: 有监督分类通过带标签样本学习特征到类别的映射。向量化是输入处理，聚类是不同的无监督设置。
distractorsZh: 这描述聚类而非利用已知标签的分类。
词频矩阵是表示，不是类别预测。
类别通常在训练任务中给定。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: Two documents in class C have vectors (1,3) and (3,5). What is their arithmetic-mean centroid?
options: (1,3), because a centroid must be an observed point.
(3,5), because the longest document defines the center.
questions.explanationZh: μ(C)=1/|D_C| Σv(d)，所以平均为(2,4)。用指定距离或相似度选择最近质心；质心不必是实际样本，归一化的先后也必须一致。
distractorsZh: 这是medoid可能满足的限制，不是均值质心。
定义不是选择最长向量。
这是总和，漏除样本数2。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What objective does least-squares fitting minimize?
options: Selecting the vocabulary item with the highest document frequency.
Reducing squared prediction residuals.
Maximizing the number of unlabeled clusters.
Counting only points exactly on a support margin.
questions.explanationZh: 最小二乘最小化平方残差和，例如Σ(y_i−ŷ_i)²。它强调预测误差的大小，不等同聚类数、边界支持点数量或词频。
distractorsZh: 词频选择不是最小二乘定义。
聚类数不是回归残差目标。
这是另一种间隔视角。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What is the main aim of a discriminant projection for classification?
options: A representation or projection that helps separate classes.
A guarantee that all original coordinates are preserved exactly.
A rule that replaces every class with a random label.
The requirement to use only one training example in total.
questions.explanationZh: 判别投影寻找对类别区分有用的方向或表示；它可以牺牲无关变化，不能保证原坐标和所有距离原样保留。
distractorsZh: 有判别意义的投影不等于无损保留坐标。
标签随机化不在图中。
图明显含多个类别样本。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What role do prototypes play in a prototype-based classifier?
options: They are always the two observations closest to an SVM boundary.
They encode the exact posterior probability of every sample.
They are padding tokens added at sentence boundaries.
They provide reference representatives against which samples can be compared.
questions.explanationZh: 原型是类别或局部结构的代表，用于和新样本比较。原型不必是SVM支持向量，也不天然携带后验概率。
distractorsZh: 与第37页支持向量视角不同。
图没有提供概率数值。
本节是分类几何不是文本卷积。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: Which observations chiefly determine a hard-margin SVM separator in the support-vector view?
options: Every possible unseen observation equally, before it is observed.
Only the class names and no feature vectors.
